descriptive: gain retained = thinned change / natural change (whole month and non-LIRF)
per-airport change on the thinned regime, especially the thinned airports
matched / unmatched non-LIRF on the thinned regime
gate: The selection proceeds to export if, on BOTH thinned months, the candidate's whole-month RMSE is below the thinned control's AND the paired-day 95% interval (run_adsb_v11.paired_days, seed of configs/adsb_rnn_v1.json) of the RMSE difference lies below zero. Otherwise no export without the user's decision. This check can only block; it never changes the selected candidate or its weights.
method: Context tokens of the month rebuilt from the raw file and the natural and the thinned match tables (prc2026_ctx.tokens, k = 128, the round-1 window); the natural rebuild must reproduce the stored token file's content hash.

The 16 context networks re-predicted on natural and thinned inputs (tabular frame = tools/regime_measure.py features(), tokens as above) with models that never saw the month: December -> the January-November refit models, July 2025 -> the seasonal-fold models; ens_ctx = their mean. Natural re-predictions are compared with the stored predictions (max abs difference recorded).

The recipe is assembled as tools/regime_measure.py recipe_values(), from the committee/LIRF tables and residual members it saved (runs/coverage_regime/measure/<month>/predictions.parquet), with the committee-mix network table and share as a parameter: control (v26) and candidate, natural and thinned. The natural control must reproduce the recorded v26 RMSE, the natural candidate the development result of ctx_b100_s65 for the month (both within 1e-6 s when the natural re-predictions reproduce the stored ones).
purpose: Ship check for the candidate selected by configs/adsb_ctx_v1.json (ctx_b100_s65, docs/adsb_ctx/development_results.json): does its development gain survive the ranking months' adsb.lol coverage? Declared after that selection and before any thinned score of the context network.
